actions.action: Bottom-soak the pot for 20-30 minutes, then drain
Water when the top inch is dry, using lukewarm filtered or left-out water
Raise humidity with a humidifier, pebble tray, or grouping plants, and keep away from heater vents
Move plant back from the window if direct sun hits it for hours
Check roots at next repot and go up one pot size if root-bound
Watch for root rot signs if soil stays wet and leaves keep drooping
Check leaf undersides for spider mite webbing or speckling
